title: Post-Grokking Collapse at the Representation-Readout Interface in Muon-Trained Transformers
summary: Post-Grokking Collapse at the Representation-Readout Interface in Muon-Trained Transformers｜Under the standard split, Muon gets hidden matrices and AdamW embeddings/output head. Mu

extra.description: Under the standard split, Muon gets hidden matrices and AdamW embeddings/output head. Muon groks modular addition faster, but its solutions do not hold. All nine configurations on $(a+b) \bmod 113$ grok and later lose generalization. Across five seeds the selected AdamW reference falls below threshold on four, reaching 27.59%. Instability persists across two moduli, two widths, two training fractions, subtraction, and depth. The failure arises at the representation-readout interface, identified
